project: Qumështorja VITA - Premium Dairy Landing Page
theme: Light theme, minimalistic yet luxurious, Awwwards-level design

headings.rules: Never use Inter or standard sans for headings. Use fluid large scales (text-5xl to text-7xl for hero) and tighten letter spacing.

body.rules: Use for all paragraphs, labels, and small UI text. Maintain a high degree of legibility and clean geometric aesthetic.

colors.rules: Anchor the design on white/off-white backgrounds to represent purity and milk. Use the signature VITA blue (#007BFF) for primary actions and accents. Introduce fresh green to signify farms and sustainability.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft, diffuse colored shadows instead of harsh black drops. e.g. shadow-[0_20px_40px_-15px_rgba(0,123,255,0.15)]
visual_enhancers.gradients: Subtle mesh gradients in backgrounds using light blue and green, animated softly.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-12, p-16, py-24, py-32 for sections to let content breathe.
patterns: Bento Grid for Quality and Sustainability sections
Cinematic Full-screen Hero (100vh) with absolute positioned elements

interactions: Kinetic text reveal on hero load (masked line-by-line)
Hover zoom and 3D tilt effects on Product Cards
Parallax scrolling for background farm imagery
Cursor glow and mouse trail for premium feel
motion.rules: Motion must be purposeful, fluid, and premium. Avoid bouncy or frantic animations.

3d_and_creative_libraries.recommendations: Use framer-motion for UI choreography. Consider 'react-fast-marquee' for a slow editorial marquee. Consider simple SVG masking for milk splash transitions.

components_and_sections.name: Header / Navbar
components_and_sections.specs: Transparent initially, transitions to glassmorphism on scroll. Menu links: Home, Products, Recipes, About, Quality, Farmers, Sustainability, Contact. Include a 'data-testid' on links.

components_and_sections.name: Hero Section
components_and_sections.specs: 100vh. Background image with slow scale animation. Large headline 'Fresh Thinking. Fresh Dairy.' using text split reveal. Buttons: Explore Products (Primary, Magnetic) + Watch Story (Play icon, glassmorphic).

components_and_sections.name: Product Showcase
components_and_sections.specs: Horizontal animated slider using framer-motion. Tabs: Milk, Yogurt, Cooking Cream, Cheese, Butter. Cards feature hover zoom, subtle 3D tilt, and dynamic color backgrounds matching product type.

components_and_sections.name: Farm-to-Table Journey
components_and_sections.specs: Vertical scroll-linked animation path (Cow -> Farm -> Collection -> Factory -> Supermarket). Use staggered reveals as the user scrolls down.

components_and_sections.name: Quality & Impact
components_and_sections.specs: Bento split layout. Include animated counters: 20+ Years, 280+ Employees, Thousands of Farmers. Add certificates as badges.

components_and_sections.name: Recipes
components_and_sections.specs: Grid layout with filter tabs. High-quality imagery, glassmorphic recipe cards.

components_and_sections.name: Footer
components_and_sections.specs: Large, premium layout. Off-white or deep blue background. Newsletter signup, large typography.

hero_farm.description: Black and white cow on green grass field, used for Hero section parallax background

milk_pouring.description: Person pouring fresh milk, suitable for 'Farm to Table' or Quality section

milk_splash.description: Dynamic milk splash on dark background, used for high-contrast dramatic transitions or product highlights

product_bottles.description: Bottles of milk for product gallery placeholders

sunset_farm.description: Sunset at farm, used for Sustainability or About Us sections

accessibility_and_testing.rules: Ensure all text has sufficient contrast, especially text over images. Use text shadows if necessary. Add data-testid to ALL interactive elements (buttons, nav links, form inputs).

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement pure HTML/Tailwind for the marketing layouts instead of rigid Shadcn structural components.
Ensure 'Cabinet Grotesk' is used exclusively for Headings and 'Manrope' for body.
Do not use generic Inter font. Do not use flat blue without depth. Everything must feel premium.
Add 'data-testid' to every interactive element for automated testing.
Ensure the application container is NOT center-aligned globally.
Use pure CSS or framer-motion for the milk splash and hover transitions.
Load fonts from Google Fonts and Fontshare in index.html or index.css.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic AI slop.
Create depth through layered design elements and z-index hierarchy.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Never apply universal transitions (transition: all). Target specific properties.
Do not use AI assistant emoji characters.
Include hover states, active states, and focus states for all interactive elements.
